what: Issue #85 Stage 2 full BF16 input-R diagnostic: host grid plus L=32/L=16 device validation and throughput

r_fp32_capability.reason: r_memory and input_memory select placement only; _reader_input_dtypes returns BF16 for all R components. No existing argument changes R dtype.

unperformed: FP32-R device configuration, because existing arguments cannot select an FP32 R dtype
conclusion: BF16 input quantization moves the inverse and beam-pattern truth at high condition numbers; with R rounded before the device path, L=32 and L=16 kernel/reference errors pass the unchanged 1e-2 threshold. HiFi4 is only marginally better than HiFi3 for L=32 batch=4; large-case throughput was measured for both sizes.
